meta.title: BAFS 答題格式卡
meta.subject: DSE bafs
meta.note: 原創答題格式，不是考評局評卷參考的原文。

cards.title: Income statement line order
steps: Sales（銷貨）
less cost of sales（減：銷貨成本）
= gross profit（毛利）
plus other income / less other operating expenses（其他收入／其他營運開支）
= net profit from operations（除稅前經營溢利）
less interest and tax（利息及稅項）
= net profit（純利）
cards.trap: Do not bury cost of sales inside administration expenses; the examiner expects the trading section to be visible.

cards.title: Statement of financial position layout
steps: Non-current assets（非流動資產）
Current assets（流動資產）
= total assets（資產總額）
Capital and reserves（資本及儲備）
Non-current liabilities（非流動負債）
Current liabilities（流動負債）
= total equity and liabilities（權益及負債總額）
cards.trap: The two sides must be equal, so check assets = liabilities + equity before writing it up.

cards.title: Gross and net margin
steps: State both formulas: GPM = gross profit / sales; NPM = net profit / sales
Substitute the figures and give each as a percentage to one decimal place
Interpret each in one sentence against last year or a competitor
cards.trap: Margin uses sales revenue as the denominator; do not slip a mark-up formula in here.

cards.title: Mark-up versus margin
steps: Mark-up = gross profit / cost of sales
Margin = gross profit / sales revenue
Convert one into the other with: margin = mark-up / (1 + mark-up)
cards.trap: Same numbers give different percentages because the denominators differ, so always name which one you used.

cards.title: Liquidity pair
steps: Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities
Quick ratio = (current assets - inventory) / current liabilities
Comment on whether short-term debts are covered, and note if a very high ratio suggests idle resources
cards.trap: A quick ratio below 1 with heavy inventory dependence is a warning sign worth naming.

cards.title: Gearing comment
steps: Choose the ratio used, for example debt to equity or debt to total assets
Substitute the year-one and year-two figures
Comment: higher gearing raises financial risk and also magnifies the return to shareholders
Refer to interest cover if it is given in the case
cards.trap: A ratio without a statement about interest cover in the context is usually marked incomplete.

cards.title: Double-entry mini stub
steps: Name the transaction and the accounts affected
Write the debit side, then the credit side, using the increase rules for assets, expenses, liabilities, capital and income
State the effect on the accounting equation, assets = liabilities + capital
cards.trap: A trial balance only proves that total debits equal total credits; it does not prove the entries were right.

cards.title: MPF or ethics short answer
steps: State the principle or rule that applies, without inventing a statutory figure
Apply it to the case in one sentence
Name one risk the situation creates
Name one control, such as disclosure, approval or segregation of duties
cards.trap: Keep the Hong Kong legal wording conservative; cite specific statutory percentages only if the question supplies them.
